p1.title: SkyCourt Enterprise WMS & Supervisor Suite
p1.description: A production warehouse and operations suite for an industrial fabrication company. Office reservations and dock-side physical dispatch are split into a two-operator verification flow, every stock movement lands in a database-enforced append-only ledger, and a companion Arabic-first supervisor app lets field teams draft material requests against live inventory. All of it runs on a shared, dependency-free domain kernel with versioned schema contracts.
features: Two-Operator Dispatch: Office Reservation → Dock Confirmation
Immutable Movement Ledger Enforced by SQL Triggers
SHA-256 Idempotency Engine for Unstable Plant Networks
Exact 3-Decimal Inventory Reconciliation & Drift Detection
Purchase Order Lifecycle with Partial Receiving
Arabic-First Supervisor App with Cloud-Synced Material Requests

p2.title: Queen Hive Multi-Agent Orchestrator
p2.description: A visual orchestration platform that chains specialised AI coding agents into pipelines (Scout → Test Writer → Coder → Reviewer) and runs them against any codebase. One adapter layer drives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and AGY; runs stream live over Server-Sent Events; and verification gates automatically send failed work back for repair.
features: Drag-and-Drop Agent Pipeline Canvas (React Flow)
Unified Adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode & AGY
Live SSE Run Transcripts & Step Telemetry
Automatic Verify → Repair Loops on Failed Runs
queenctl CLI with Submit & Doctor Diagnostics
Benchmark Harness with Token & Cost Accounting

Full Arabic RTL HR Dashboard & Campaign Setup Workflows

PDF Slide Vector Grounding with Kalman Equation OCR

p11.title: Texture Extractor for Blender
p11.description: A commercial Blender extension that turns any perspective photo into clean, front-on textures and UV-mapped meshes, entirely offline. A bundled SAM 2.1 segmentation model handles click-to-select, custom projective-geometry code removes perspective distortion, and GPU-drawn overlays make every step interactive. It ships cross-platform for Windows, macOS and Linux.
features: Click-to-Select AI Segmentation with On-Device SAM 2.1
4-Point Homography Perspective Rectification
Procedural UV-Mapped Mesh Fitting at the 3D Cursor
Least-Squares Ellipse Fitting for Arches & Curves
GPU Shader Viewport Overlays & Modal Tools with Undo
Cross-Platform Bundles: Windows, macOS & Linux (x64/ARM)

p12.title: O2mation Omnichannel AI Support

Human agents can claim any conversation from a live WebSocket queue and take over in real time, while usage is metered through race-safe PostgreSQL credit functions tied to subscription plans.
features: Telegram & Meta Webhook Ingestion with Signature Checks
Document-Grounded Answers from Uploaded PDFs
Live Human Takeover via WebSocket Chat Queue
Voice-Note Understanding with Native Gemini Audio
Race-Safe Credit Metering via Locked Postgres RPCs
Tenant Isolation with Row-Level Security & Encrypted Tokens

features: Sub-200ms Turnaround Latency (184ms RTT) Telephony Bridge
Dual-Channel WebRTC Audio Oscilloscope & Frequency Spectrum
Realtime Interruption Alert with 38ms Twilio Buffer Purge
Autonomous Tool-Calling SMS Verification & Egyptian Arabic Synthesis

p14.title: Split Diffusion Private AI Imaging
p14.description: A distributed image-generation and inpainting system that keeps prompts and pixels on the user's own machine. Encoding and decoding happen locally; only anonymous latent tensors travel through an integrity-checked object relay to remote cloud GPUs for the heavy denoising. It comes with a desktop app, a one-command CLI and an extensive failure-mode test suite.
features: Local Encode/Decode: Prompts & Pixels Never Leave the Device
Remote GPU Worker Daemon for Cloud Denoising
Object-Relay Protocol with SHA-256 Integrity & Nonces
Cloudflare R2 Transport with Automatic Fallback
Desktop Inpainting App & One-Command Roundtrip CLI
Boundary Tests for Corrupt Relays, Dropouts & Retries

p15.title: Blender ↔ Painter LiveLink
p15.description: A commercial two-way bridge between Blender and Substance 3D Painter that removes the export/import grind from texturing. Geometry edits in Blender hot-reload into Painter without losing a single paint layer, and exported texture maps flow straight back into Blender where the full material node graph is wired automatically.
features: Mesh Hot-Reload into Painter with Layer Stacks Preserved
Automatic Principled BSDF Material Node Wiring
Background File Watcher for Zero-Stutter Texture Refresh
Docked Qt Control Panel Inside Painter
Per-Channel Export Formats, Resolutions & UDIMs
Automated Release Builds for Both Host Applications
